mentions.name: gipity
mentions.description: A cloud-first reimplementation of OpenClaw that works with no setup or install, released in an early version for feedback.
mentions.problem: OpenClaw-style agents otherwise require local setup and installation; this version runs in the cloud instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've written my own version of OpenClaw, but it's cloud-first so no setup or install. An early release, but I think its pretty neat and I'd appreciate any feedback: https://gipity.ai
